claims.statement: Strict numerical occurrence identity at every boundary is not necessary when an actual transduction edge produces a distinct successor occurrence.
claims.domain: one fixed P,I,K,B and the declared 36-world boundary-mode model
claims.counterexample: ADC/transduction modes I-T, T-I and T-T

claims.statement: Actual local links joined at both interfaces by identity relay or actual transduction concatenate into a directed route.
claims.domain: one actual event graph with identical bearer, interval, signature and boundary bindings

claims.statement: Value equality at both boundaries does not identify route lineage.
claims.counterexample: five equal-value nonroute mode pairs versus four route pairs

claims.statement: Finite E_lineage evidence is not identical to the ontic Transduce relation.
Lineage route existence does not imply a unique source, maximal process or subject.
claims.counterexample: branching and merging lineage in overlapping processes

claims.statement: C1 transports an admitted lineage-stitched organization but does not supply H_cf, ownership, agency, conceptual self or report semantics.
claims.domain: one admitted actual P in complete K
claims.proof: same-instance structural transport with semantic residual
claims.counterexample: same organization with ungrounded external label
